crossRefs.note: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor…
to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to reason the cause with you. Why does the way of…
May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in…
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no…

translations.web: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
translations.bsb: Therefore listen to me, O men of understanding. Far be it from God to do wrong, and from the Almighty to act unjustly.
translations.kjv: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
translations.asv: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
